name: Contagion Fear
description: Terrified that closeness will infect them with other people's damage
behavioral_signature: Maintains emotional distance to avoid absorbing others' pain
under_stress: Cuts people off entirely rather than risk contamination
at_rest: Helpful from a distance, friendly but unreachable
will_never: merge fully with another person's pain
unless: the person in pain is someone they've already lost barriers with
